name: Bind Spirit V
body:
School conjuration (calling) [pact]; Level sorcerer/wizard 9, shaman 9, witch 9

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as bind spirit I†, except you summon a 5thlevel pact spirit of your choice and bind it to your soul.
